propositions: CodeQL's weekly cron (23 4 * * 1) was intended as a between-pushes backstop but became the primary scan of newly-landed code after push-on-main was removed, leaving SAST findings unscanned for up to 7 days.
CodeQL must migrate from weekly to 6-hourly cron (35 */6 * * *) to restore pre-push-removal coverage and align with the operator-specified scheduled CI replacement cadence.
The stale header comment asserting a 28x cost increase and deliberate opt-out from 6-hourly scheduling must be removed, as navapbc/rebar is public and GitHub-hosted CI is free.
CodeQL's 6-hourly minute (35) must be staggered distinctly from sibling lanes (test.yml :41, optionality.yml :47, verify-identity.yml :53) to avoid GitHub scheduler congestion.

Test coverage in test_ci_main_push_policy.py must retarget CodeQL's cadence from weekly to 6-hourly while preserving no-push and workflow_dispatch assertions, and add new assertions for cron staggering invariants.
CodeQL keeps no push trigger, no reintroduction of push-on-main, and workflow_dispatch remains unchanged.
